items.question: What is the License NFT?
items.answer: Every Melusina instance gets a License NFT on Solana, bound to your domain. It's the root of your trust chain. Any third party can verify your license is legitimate by checking the blockchain—no trust required.

items.question: Can I upgrade from Cloud to Self-Hosted?
items.answer: Yes. Export your Pearls anytime and migrate to your own infrastructure. Your License NFT transfers with you. We'll help with the keyholder setup and DANE configuration.

items.question: Can I upgrade from Self-Hosted to Licensed?
items.answer: Yes. Pay the difference and receive full source code access, a Reseller NFT, and redistribution rights. You can then issue your own License NFTs to your customers.

items.question: Why SOL for cloud billing?
items.answer: Every payment is verified on-chain via Solana getTransaction(). No payment gateways. No chargebacks. No intermediaries. Cryptographic proof of payment that's verifiable by anyone.

items.question: What happens after 5 years of updates?
items.answer: You can renew Foundation-signed updates at 20% of the original price per year. Or continue using the last release you have—it's yours. The License NFT remains valid on-chain regardless.

items.question: How do threshold keyholders work?
items.answer: You choose M-of-N (e.g., 2-of-3). Each keyholder gets a Keyholder NFT on Solana. Critical operations like Vault unseal, backup decryption, and CA rotation require M keyholders to approve via signed Memo transactions.
